prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal region of Kaski, Nepal. The camera advances through a narrow path bordered by wooden posts, revealing a dense, snowy landscape under a diffused daylight that casts a soft, muted glow over the scene. As the viewer progresses, the trail curves gently, flanked by leafless trees and rocky outcrops partially buried in snow, emphasizing the wintry conditions. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive experience of navigating the terrain. The environment is serene and untouched, with no other individuals present, enhancing the sense of solitude. The path continues to wind through the forested area, with the camera occasionally panning slightly to capture the surrounding trees and the thick blanket of snow covering the ground. The light gradually shifts as the trail leads deeper into the forest, creating subtle variations in shadow and brightness. The journey is smooth, with the camera maintaining a consistent pace, offering a continuous and detailed view of the natural beauty of this remote, snowy mountain trail.
